intent: The rebind confirmation's consequence takes the consequence role — the heaviest blast radius in the product wearing the lightest box.
rationale: Rebinding replaces an agent's whole materialized configuration: context modules, signal rules, prose, timeframe. The platform's own tool description calls it destructive and says 'this is not a merge'. That sentence is the single most consequential string this product renders, and it sits in `rebind-confirm.tsx` in `border border-border-default` — the anonymous box DT-0004 retired precisely because a consequence rendered as one more paragraph gets skimmed. Nothing else about this component changes: the buttons already come from the shared constants, and the submit stays accent per DT-0002 (the weight belongs on the block, not on a hazard-coloured control).

design.layout: Unchanged in order; the action row stacks under the tablet breakpoint and sits inline above it.

default.content: consequence: the block takes the consequence role — color.consequence.subtle background, 1px color.consequence.border border, radius.2, space.4 padding, color.text.primary. role=alert stays; the destination name, its revision, and the replacement sentence all stay verbatim. rebind-confirm: the action row becomes a column at space.3 gap turning to a wrapped row at breakpoint.tablet, both controls full width below it.

responsive.mobile: Buttons stacked, each full width, each at the size.control.min floor.

acceptance: The consequence block renders on color.consequence.subtle with a 1px color.consequence.border border at radius.2, and keeps role=alert
The destination's platform-supplied name and revision still render inside the block, verbatim
At a 320px viewport the submit and cancel are stacked, each full width, each at least size.control.min tall
At tablet width and above the two controls sit inline as they do today
The submit remains accent-styled, never danger — DT-0002's ruling, restated in control.ts
Zero copy changes anywhere on the component
No raw color, spacing, or size literal is introduced

references.value: Backlog 166. Applies DT-0004's consequence role to the component with the product's largest blast radius.
